{{Top|leg}}
'''Relaali''' was a negotiator of the [[Omenada]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] tradition who brokered peace between the rival [[Mining/Legends|mining]] companies [[Tor-Ro-Bo Industries]] and [[Eeook Corporation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[244Core]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. For his efforts, a [[Relaali Zone One|city]] on 244Core was named after him.<ref name="The Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
